message:
Running command: cd /tmp; PYTHONPATH=/tmp/hyb python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
print(pd.__file__)
mi = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples([("a", "b"), ("c", "d"), ("b", np.nan)])
s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3], index=mi)
import pandas.core.indexes.multi as M
orig = M.MultiIndex._recode_for_new_levels
def spy(self, new_levels, *, copy):
    print("  recode: target nlevels", self.nlevels, "new_levels", len(new_levels), list(self))
    return orig(self, new_levels, copy=copy)
M.MultiIndex._recode_for_new_levels = spy
for k in [pd.Index([("a", "b"), ("a", "b", "c")], tupleize_cols=False), [("a", "b"), ("a", "b", "c")], pd.Index([("a", "b", "c"), ("c", "d", "e")], tupleize_cols=False),[("a", "b", "c"), ("c", "d", "e")]]:
    print(type(k).__name__, mi.get_indexer(k), s.reindex(k).tolist())
print(s.loc[[("a","b","c")]])
try: s.loc[("a","b","c")]
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
try: mi.isin([("a","b","c")])
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)
print(pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(np.array([("a", "b"), ("a", "b", "c")], dtype=object)).tolist())
print(pd.Index([1, 2]).map(lambda x: ("a", "b") if x == 1 else ("a", "b", "c")).tolist())
df = pd.DataFrame({"v":[1,2,3]}, index=mi)
print(df.reindex(pd.Index([("a", "b"), ("a", "b", "c")], tupleize_cols=False)))
EOF
